unit.title: Verb Tenses and a Day in Your Life

contentBlocks.text: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਅੱਜ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਵਰਤੋ! (You've learned three tenses and daily-life words. Today, use it all!)

Write 3 sentences about a day: one about something you did this morning (past tense, using ਉੱਠਿਆ/ਉੱਠੀ or ਗਿਆ/ਗਈ), one about something happening now (present tense), and one about something you will do later (future tense, using ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ/ਜਾਵਾਂਗੀ or another future verb). Read all three sentences aloud in order.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਤਿੰਨੇ ਕਾਲ ਵਰਤ ਕੇ ਲਿਖਿਆ! (You just wrote using all three tenses!) Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Write one sentence each in past, present, and future tense about a real day
Correctly apply gender agreement across all three tenses
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's three tenses and daily-life vocabulary.
2. Model one example sentence in each tense.
3. Have the child write and read aloud their own three sentences.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: provide a simple 3-row template (Morning/past, Now/present, Later/future) to scaffold the three sentences
Ready for more: ask the child to connect their three sentences into one short paragraph using a transition word
This is the week's synthesis moment — genuinely combining all three tenses into one connected piece about a real day
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended writing activity — check that the child correctly writes one sentence in each of the three tenses, with correct gender agreement throughout.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'grammar mastery' and 'daily life' goals together, synthesizing this week's full tense system into real original writing.
